== Summary ==
Sealed Vintage Sports Cards "Collectible Card Game" repack box, first series, with the printed "Over $45 Value For Only $14.99" badge. Visible packs include a Young Jedi pack, two [[Reflections]] packs, a Limited Edition Light Side starter deck, [[Premiere Unlimited]], two [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]], [[Tatooine]], and [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]]. Cropped. Article: [[Unofficial repackaged products]].
